metadata.orrery:spec:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Rendered with orrery (github.com/Sagargupta16/orrery): # orrery render images/diagrams/architecture.yaml -o images/diagrams/architecture -f svg --theme both # Reviewed at README width: orrery review images/diagrams/architecture.yaml --width 880 title: GitScope architecture subtitle: The extension and the website call the GitHub API from your browser; only the Worker holds the OAuth client secret. direction: down layout: merge: false story: [profile, content, sw, api]
groups: browser: { type: boundary, label: Your browser } ext: type: box label: GitScope extension (Manifest V3) icon: tabler:puzzle in: browser evidence: src/manifest.json:2#manifest_version
nodes: site: icon: logos:react label: GitScope website note: React 19 on GitHub Pages in: browser evidence: [website/vite.config.ts:27#outDir, .github/workflows/pages.yml:68#deploy-pages] profile: icon: github:browser label: github.com profile note: stats panel in the sidebar in: browser evidence: src/js/dashboard.js:305#injectDashboard signin: icon: tabler:key label: Sign-in note: popup + OAuth callback in: ext evidence: [src/manifest.json:39#default_popup, src/manifest.json:33#auth-callback.js] content: icon: tabler:layout-sidebar-right label: Content script note: "detects profiles, 5 min cache" in: ext evidence: [src/manifest.json:24#content.js, src/js/api.js:191#getCached] sw: icon: tabler:engine label: Service worker note: "background.js, keeps the token" in: ext evidence: [src/manifest.json:13#service_worker, src/js/background.js:72#GPI_AUTH] oauth: icon: github:shield-lock label: GitHub OAuth note: authorize + token align: worker evidence: worker/index.js:84#authorize worker: icon: logos:cloudflare-workers-icon label: gpi-auth Worker note: "Cloudflare, holds the client secret" evidence: [worker/wrangler.toml:1#gpi-auth, worker/index.js:123#client_secret] api: icon: logos:graphql label: GitHub API note: GraphQL + REST evidence: [src/js/background.js:84#api.github.com/graphql, website/src/lib/http.ts:1#api.github.com]
edges: - content -> profile: { label: injects dashboard, constraint: false, evidence: src/js/content.js:74#injectDashboard } - content -> sw: { label: runtime message, evidence: src/js/api.js:93#sendMessage } - signin -> sw: { label: save token, evidence: src/js/auth-callback.js:14#saveToken } - sw -> api: { label: parameterized GraphQL, evidence: src/js/background.js:84#fetch } - signin -> worker: { label: /login, evidence: src/js/popup.js:38#AUTH_URL } - site -> worker: { label: /web/login, evidence: website/src/lib/auth.ts:89#web/login } - site -> api: { label: REST + GraphQL, evidence: website/src/lib/http.ts:73#fetch } - worker -> oauth: { label: code exchange, evidence: worker/index.js:118#access_token }

svg.title: GitScope architecture
svg.desc: GitScope architecture. 8 components in 2 groups. Connections: Content script to github.com profile (injects dashboard); Content script to Service worker (runtime message); Sign-in to Service worker (save token); Service worker to GitHub API (parameterized GraphQL); Sign-in to gpi-auth Worker (/login); GitScope website to gpi-auth Worker (/web/login); GitScope website to GitHub API (REST + GraphQL); gpi-auth Worker to GitHub OAuth (code exchange).

text.tspan: The extension and the website call the GitHub API from your browser; only the Worker holds the OAuth client secret.
